name: Mark Ferrari 8-bit dynamic palette cycling engine runs 60 FPS color shifts
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball with multiple palette color bands, switching to the Cycle Engine tab, and toggling live 60 FPS Mark Ferrari palette cycling.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select color swatch #1 from the palette, and click inside the circle to color it
Select the Pen tool (press B), choose color swatch #2, and paint stripes across the ball
Verify the multicolored ball is clearly visible on the canvas
Click the 'Palette' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 8-Bit Dynamic Palette Cycling controls appear with play toggle, speed multiplier, and track lists
Verify the palette cycle engine starts active 60 FPS dynamic color rotation on the canvas
Verify the cycling engine pauses and original pixel colors are preserved
